Nine clade names are kept as internal labels: THEROPODA, NEOTHEROPODA, TETANURAE and COELUROSAURIA (beside node dots) and the five band names, each band spanning one clade (COELOPHYSOIDEA, ABELISAUROIDEA, ALLOSAUROIDEA, TYRANNOSAUROIDEA, COMPSOGNATHIDAE). Multi-way nodes: five tyrannosauroids (Santanaraptor, Stokesosaurus, Daspletosaurus, Albertosaurus libratus and the rest) and Tyrannosaurus bataar, T. rex and Timimus. 44 tips, 2 polytomies (5, 3 children); 9 printed clade names kept as internal node labels.
